name: Remove Odor-Proof Cannabis Storage Rule
why: Removes the requirement that cannabis in a vehicle be kept in an odor-proof container.

name: Credit for Change
why: Offers day-for-day sentence credit for good behavior from day one to most incarcerated people.

name: Felony Murder Reform
why: Replaces felony murder as first-degree murder with a separate offense sentenced by role and intent.

name: Expand Public Defender Representation
why: Lets public defenders represent their criminal clients in related license suspension or revocation hearings.

name: Mandatory Supervised Release Reform
why: Lets people on mandatory supervised release earn a day of credit for each day served.

name: Expand Affordable Housing Donation Tax Credit
why: Extends and increases the affordable housing donation income tax credit program through 2036.

name: Ban Criminalizing Homelessness
why: Bars governments from fining or penalizing unsheltered homeless people for necessary daily activities in public.

name: Build Illinois Homes Act
why: Creates state tax credits for developers building or rehabilitating low-income affordable housing.

name: Cap Municipal Parking Mandates
why: Caps municipal minimum parking requirements at 0.5 spaces per multifamily unit and 1 per single-family home.

name: Circuit Breaker Property Tax Relief Act
why: Provides property tax relief grants to income-eligible homeowners who have had property tax bill spikes.

name: Ban Credit Score Rental Bias
why: Bars landlords from denying a rental applicant with a housing subsidy based on credit score or history.

name: Disability Homestead Exemption Renewal
why: Lets assessors permanently renew the homestead exemption for people with disabilities without annual reapplication.

name: Restore Disparate Impact Protections
why: Makes it a civil rights violation to use practices that have a discriminatory effect, not just intent.

name: End Crime-Free Housing Evictions
why: Bars evicting tenants under crime-free housing ordinances for alleged nuisance activity, including calling for emergency help.

name: Faith-Based Housing and Mixed-Use By-Right Act
why: Allows by-right multifamily and mixed-use housing development on land owned by faith-based organizations.

name: Property Tax Sale Reform
why: Reforms the tax sale system to comply with a Supreme Court ruling requiring that home equity in excess of property tax debt owed be returned to the homeowner.

name: Home for Good Act
why: Creates a statewide program providing housing and reentry services to people leaving incarceration.

name: Fund the Home Illinois Program
why: Appropriates $352.2 million from the General Revenue Fund for grants under the Home Illinois Program.

name: Fund Homeless Student Education Grants
why: Appropriates $5 million to support programming for students experiencing or at risk of homelessness.

name: Affordable Housing Planning and Appeal Act Reform
why: Expands and strengthens the Affordable Housing Planning and Appeal Act, which aims to increase affordable housing in Illinois' least affordable communities.

name: Income Property Disclosure Requirements
why: Lets counties that opt in by ordinance require income-property owners to file physical descriptions with assessors.

name: Ban Landlord Junk Fees
why: Caps application fees at $50, bans some fees outright, and allows only one deposit or move-related fee.

name: Legalize Accessory Dwellings and Middle Housing
why: Requires municipalities to allow accessory dwelling units and other middle-housing types in single-family zones.

name: Mortgage Nominee Registry and Fees
why: Creates a mortgage-nominee registry; a $150 fee funds rental housing support, and $25 of a county fee funds affordable housing.

name: Ban PHA Work Requirements
why: Prohibits housing authorities from imposing time limits or work requirements for eligibility, unless federally required.

name: Set Building Plan Review Deadlines
why: Sets deadlines for municipal plan reviews and inspections, allowing third-party reviewers if towns miss them.

name: Simplify Senior Tax Freeze Renewal
why: Lets counties with 3 million or more residents renew the senior tax freeze exemption without a new application.

name: Allow Single-Stair Residential Buildings
why: Bars local building codes from prohibiting single-stairway exits in qualifying residential buildings.

name: Legalize Small-Lot and Middle Housing
why: Requires municipalities to allow small-lot single-family homes and conversions to middle-housing types.

name: Standardize Municipal Impact Fees
why: Requires municipalities to calculate development impact fees using a standard formula issued by the state.

name: Reform Property Tax Sale Process
why: Lets counties acquire tax-delinquent property directly and compensates owners for lost equity in tax sales.

name: Notify Tenants of Tax Sales
why: Requires notifying tenants when their rental property faces a delinquent property tax sale application.
